description: This file defines Express.js routes for session tracking data, including endpoints for listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, deleting, and generating duration histograms. It includes data normalization functions, caching mechanisms, and Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts various representations of numbers, including Decimal128 and string, to plain JavaScript numbers, returning NaN if parsing fails.

methods.name: normalizeSessionDoc
methods.description: Normalizes a session document by ensuring total_cost, cost_history[].total_cost, and agent_costs values are numbers, defaulting to 0 if invalid.

methods.name: computePercentiles
methods.description: Calculates statistical percentiles (median, p90, p95) along with min, max, and count for an array of numeric values.

methods.name: parseHistogramParams
methods.description: Validates and parses query parameters for the duration-histogram endpoint, including scope, userId, tenantId, start/end dates, and bin size.

methods.name: buildMatchFilter
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB filter object based on parsed histogram parameters for querying session durations.

methods.name: buildBinsFromGroups
methods.description: Transforms aggregation group results into histogram bins with start, end, and count.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached histogram data if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Stores histogram data in cache with a TTL of 5 minutes.

methods.name: buildCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a deterministic cache key string based on histogram query parameters.
